integrity: The separation cone and tie boundaries follow from exact quota and priority inequalities. A standard-library verifier independently implements both correspondences with exact rational arithmetic, checks 222680 strictly ordered integer triples, both boundaries, bounded two-claimant correspondence equality, and the global primitive minimum witness search.
scientific_limitations: The new classification is restricted to unconstrained apportionment with three claimants and house size two. It does not impose a one-seat minimum, and it does not classify larger houses or higher-dimensional claimant sets.
title: The first Hamilton–Webster separation is an exact three-claimant cone
